direction.doc: Direction the incoming frame pushes in; the outgoing frame is pushed away in the same direction

doc: Push: both frames translate together by one full screen in direction; offset s = round(progress × size along that axis). Each output pixel is an **exact pixel copy** from one of the two frames (no blending, no resampling), so progress = 0 / 1 is byte-identical to from / to. Using direction = left as an example: where x < W − s, take from[x + s]; otherwise take to[x − (W − s)].
